**Sequence analysis: Its past, present, and future**

by Tim F. Liao, Danilo Bolano, Christian Brzinsky-Fay, Benjamin Cornwell, Anette Eva Fasang, Satu Helske, Raffaella Piccarreta, Marcel Raab, Gilbert Ritschard, Emanuela Struffolino and Matthias Studer

*Social Science Research*, **107**, 102772. DOI: [10.1016/j.ssresearch.2022.102772](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.ssresearch.2022.102772) (open access)

The article reviews the development of sequence analysis in the social sciences, takes stock of current methodological practice and outlines directions for future research. See also the [overview of community books](../../../resources.qmd#overview) on our Resources page.
